liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Estimated Prophet** (5 reviews): Second set opens with Shakedown Street and includes a sizzling Estimated Prophet into Eyes of the World; The first Estimated jam keeps climbing, with Jerry and Bobby lifting it repeatedly; the second jam has many peaks and valleys [7][8][11][16][17]
- **Tennessee Jed** (3 reviews): Bobby plays slide guitar on Tennessee Jed, a high point of the reviewer's years of Dead travels; The track labeled Minglewood after Candyman is really Tennessee Jed, so later titles shift down one, explaining the untitled final song [6][7][16]
- **Shakedown Street** (3 reviews): Shakedown Street is called potentially worth the download by itself; Shakedown is tight and very funky, with Bob's rhythmic fills especially praised [14][15][17]
- **Eyes of the World** (3 reviews): Eyes is solid throughout, with a blissful peak in the jam after the final verse; Garcia's fast, speedy licks in Eyes are singled out [8][9][17]
- **Lazy Lightning** (2 reviews): Tennessee Jed and Lazy Lightning into Supplication are described as smoking; Lazy Lightning into Supplication rocks the house, with Phil playing a high-note figure [11][16]
- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): Jerry reaches for high notes in Wharf Rat, which the reviewer treats as a sign of a good show; The transition from Truckin' into Wharf Rat is called picture perfect [11][15]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): The opening Sugaree stands out as a highlight for this listener [6]
- **Me and My Uncle** (1 other source): Me & My Uncle begins right at the start of its track but is complete [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Heart of Me**: earliest performance in the archive; mythic rare: 2 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd78-12-28.sbd.clugston.7487.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 174 min; rated 4.5/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording sounds very good and the show is upbeat [12]
- **gd1978-12-28.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-7487.35159.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 174 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **gd1978-12-28.145349.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 23 songs; 183 min [4]
- **gd78-12-28.aud-schug.warner.19506.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 171 min; rated 3.75/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: This audience recording is not as good as a soundboard, but suits those who like auds [14]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Garcia began playing very fast after returning from Egypt [9]
- Suggests Garcia's fast playing came from hearing Nubian player Hamza El Din's waterwheel style at the Sphinx shows [12]
- Reviewer considers this the best Estimated > Eyes version to get, and one of few tapes they'd buy on disc [8]
- The Tennessee Jed is called one of the best versions [9]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd78-12-28.sbd.clugston.7487.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Dave Cohen and Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard > Master Reel [1]
- **gd1978-12-28.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-7487.35159.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Fix of shnid 7487 by Bill Tetzeli; source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > CDR [2]. Also: A few seconds of tuning before Sugaree were pasted in from the audience source, shnid 19506; The gap between Drums and Space was removed to make it seamless; files converted to flac [2]
- **gd1978-12-28.145349.sony.ecm270.severson.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (section 404, row 8, seats 12-14) > Sony TC-158SD (TDK SA-C90) [4]. Also: A Neumann SM69 audience source from Greg Schug and Matt Smith supplies a 12-second patch in Truckin' [4]
- **gd78-12-28.aud-schug.warner.19506.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Greg Schug; source: Audience Recording: 2 Neumann SM69 mics [5]
